name: manual_c8beaa
claim: Mutating a urllib3 PoolManager's connection_pool_kw with custom per-request keys (e.g. a pinned IP, a custom checker callable) that aren't among PoolKey's fixed NamedTuple fields crashes connection_from_host()/connection_from_context() with 'PoolKey.__new__() got an unexpected keyword argument' on literally any real network call -- the crash only manifests once code reaches a genuine connection-pool lookup, so a test suite that only exercises the pre-connect validation path (and never actually calls send() against real or realistically-mocked urllib3 internals) will pass indefinitely while the feature is completely non-functional for real traffic
conditions: test never reaches real connection pool

decisions.notes: src/utils/ssrf_pinned_adapter.py's SSRFPinnedHTTPAdapter.send() mutates self.poolmanager.connection_pool_kw with pinned_ip (and, after this session's own address_checker fix, also address_checker) before calling super().send(). This predates this session entirely -- reproduced with zero mocking directly against _PinnedPoolManager().connection_from_host(), confirmed present since the module's very first commit (1932b428, 'PR-P2 shipped'). Every test in tests/test_ssrf_pinned_adapter.py before this fix either stopped at validate_resolved() (pre-connect) or used a FakeSess that bypassed requests.Session.send() entirely -- none ever reached real connection-pool key construction, so a bug that made the entire documented-as-shipped Layer-2 SSRF transport crash on any real request went undetected. Discovered only while writing a MORE FAITHFUL regression test for an unrelated CodeRabbit nitpick ('this test doesn't actually prove metadata rejection'). Fixed via urllib3's own documented extension point: a custom key_fn_by_scheme normalizer (per _default_key_normalizer's own docstring: 'provide alternate callables to key_fn_by_scheme') that excludes the non-PoolKey fields from pool-KEY construction while still passing the full, unfiltered request_context to the pool's own __init__ via connection_from_pool_key.
